newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian patients to get quotes on surgery costs.
newsitem.headline: Australian patients to get quotes on surgery costs.

text.p: The Australian government on Tuesday announced health reforms which would allow patients to get up-front quotes for doctors' fees before an operation.

Health Minister Michael Wooldridge said the reforms would promote new competition in the health industry, rewarding doctors who negotiated contracts with private hospitals and giving healths funds an incentive to cut administrative costs.
It would also mean fewer bills for patients after leaving hospital, he said in a statement.
"The government is determined to do everything in its power to make private health insurance more attractive, more affordable and more effective for more people," he said.

"It is now up to the doctors, hospitals and health funds, at an individual and collective level, to make the new opportunities work for their own mutual benefit and, more importantly, for the benefit of their patients and customers."
A spokesman for Wooldridge was not immediately available to confirm the timing of the health reform legislation's introduction into parliament.
